metas.name: Baa Baa Black Sheep
metas.description: A single misplaced object sets off a wild 24-hour chain reaction, sweeping six strangers into chaotic fun. As it changes hands, petty blunders and comic mix-ups collide, forging unexpected connections that upend all their lives forever.

metas.name: All Pass
metas.description: Three families from different parts of North Chennai come together through circumstances and, despite financial struggles, decide to live under one roof in Sathya Nagar. Their friendship grows into a close-knit bond, with the three families living like one. But when a conflict threatens this unity and puts their relationships at risk, they must face its consequences and decide whether their bond can survive.

metas.name: Band of Brothers: Legacy
metas.description: A documentary tribute to the series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company, in line with the 25th anniversary of HBO's original limited series.

metas.name: Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

metas.name: Guide
metas.description: When mistaken to be a sage by some villagers, an ex-tour guide reflects on his past and lost love to search for spiritual wisdom to guide the villagers.

metas.name: Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: Casino
metas.description: In Las Vegas, two best friends--a casino executive and a Mafia enforcer--compete for a gambling empire and a fast-living, fast-loving socialite.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: Soodhu Kavvum
metas.description: Das, with his team, kidnap Arumai, son of a politician, who has been planning his own kidnapping to extract money from his father. Problems arise, when an insane cop is brought to handle the case.

April 6th, 1917. As an infantry battalion assembles to wage war deep in enemy territory, two soldiers are assigned to race against time and deliver a message that will stop 1,600 men from walking straight into a deadly trap.

metas.name: Blade Runner
metas.description: A blade runner must pursue and terminate four replicants who stole a ship in space and have returned to Earth to find their creator.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: Hridayam
metas.description: The emotional journey of Arun, his carefree bachelor days in engineering college, and how he matures through various phases of life.

metas.name: Dune
metas.description: Paul Atreides arrives on Arrakis after his father accepts the stewardship of the dangerous planet. However, chaos ensues after a betrayal as forces clash to control melange, a precious resource.

metas.name: Hey Ram
metas.description: Saketh Ram's wife is raped and killed during direct action day riots in Calcutta. He is convinced that Mahatma Gandhi is responsible for all the problems happening in the country and sets out to kill him.
A scientist invents a time machine, which leads to a bitter battle between his evil twin brother and his son.

metas.name: Karthikeya 2
metas.description: A sequel to Karthikeya (2014), which deals with the personal problems of Karthikeya and how his pursuit of the truth leads him to find out the power of Indian ancient system and Tatva of Lord Sri Krishna.

metas.name: The Holdovers
metas.description: In 1970, a curmudgeonly history teacher at a New England boarding school remains on campus during Christmas break to supervise held over students, and ends up forming an unlikely bond with a brainy but damaged troublemaker.

metas.name: Shrek
metas.description: A mean lord exiles fairytale creatures to the swamp of a grumpy ogre, who must go on a quest and rescue a princess for the lord in order to get his land back.

metas.name: Rockstar
metas.description: Janardhan Jakhar chases his dreams of becoming a big Rock star, during which he falls in love with Heer.

metas.name: Batman: Knightfall - Part 1: Knightfall
metas.description: When the mysterious behemoth known only as Bane frees Batman's entire rogue's gallery from Arkham Asylum, the Caped Crusader is pushed to his mental and physical breaking point.

metas.name: Hi :)
metas.description: Two individuals initially exchange a simple "Hi," but through a series of chance encounters, shared experiences, and deep conversations, they gradually develop a strong connection and eventually fall in love.

metas.name: Possible Love
metas.description: Four strangers' paths cross by chance, leading to complex emotional entanglements that challenge their existing relationships and force them to confront uncomfortable truths about love and commitment.

metas.name: Godzilla Minus One
metas.description: A kamikaze pilot plagued by survivor's guilt seeks redemption when a giant monster he failed to kill is transformed by radiation from atomic bomb tests and lays siege to post-war Japan.

metas.name: Shyam Singha Roy
metas.description: Centers in the theme of reincarnation, unfolding in Kolkata and Hyderabad.

metas.name: Wick Is Pain
metas.description: The never-before-seen footage and story behind the John Wick (2014) phenomenon, from independent film to billion-dollar franchise.

metas.name: The Invite
metas.description: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places.

metas.name: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
metas.description: An NRI and his wife decide to stay in his ancestral home, paying no heed to the warnings about ghosts. Soon, inexplicable occurrences cause him to call a psychiatrist to help solve the mystery.

metas.name: Marty Supreme
metas.description: Marty Mauser, a young man with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness.

metas.name: Les Misérables
metas.description: In 19th-century France, Jean Valjean, who, for decades, has been hunted by the ruthless policeman Javert after breaking parole, agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter. The decision changes their lives forever.

metas.name: Malikappuram
metas.description: 8 year old Kallu from Panchalimedu village is unhappy that her pilgrimage to Sabarimala is delayed and decides to go with her friend.

metas.name: Mastaney
metas.description: Set in 1739, Nader Shah's undefeated army is attacked by Sikh rebellions. Nadar demands their arrest to no avail. Five civilians are hired to play Sikh rebels but over time, they learn the Sikh way.

metas.name: Mahendragiri Vaaraahi
metas.description: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

metas.name: Weapons
metas.description: When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

metas.name: Kaminey
metas.description: The desperate lives of two estranged twin brothers converge over missing drugs, politics, racial prejudice, corrupt cops and an unplanned pregnancy.

metas.name: Mardaani 2
metas.description: A 21-year old boy Sunny has a penchant for sexually assaulting and killing girls. He's locked horns with top cop Shivani Shivaji Roy. Will she nab him?

metas.name: Heart of the Beast
metas.description: After a harrowing plane crash, a Special Forces officer and his combat dog find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

metas.name: Jailer
metas.description: A retired jailer goes on a manhunt to find his son's killers. But the road leads him to a familiar, albeit a bit darker place. Can he emerge from this complex situation successfully?

metas.name: Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

metas.name: Rise of the Guardians
metas.description: When the evil spirit Pitch launches an assault on Earth, the Immortal Guardians team up to protect the innocence of children all around the world.

metas.name: Vadh
metas.description: A retired teacher and his wife endure systemic abuse from a sadistic loan shark while their son remains indifferent in America. When the criminal targets a young student, the patriarch commits a brutal, calculated murder.

metas.name: Sultan
metas.description: Sultan is a classic underdog tale about a wrestler's journey, looking for a comeback by defeating all odds.

metas.name: Viswasam
metas.description: A powerful village chief's life changes when his wife Niranjana leaves with their daughter Swetha, troubled by his role in settling disputes and intimidating enemies.

metas.name: Paa
metas.description: A father tries to help his son cope with a rare condition that causes the young boy to age beyond his years.

metas.name: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
metas.description: Brooklyn plumbers Mario and Luigi are warped to the magical Mushroom Kingdom, and Mario must team up with Princess Peach, Toad, and Donkey Kong to save Luigi from the evil Bowser.

metas.name: Kalki 2898 AD
metas.description: A pregnant woman comes under the protection of an immortal warrior while being tracked down by bounty hunters.

metas.name: Main Atal Hoon
metas.description: Follows the extraordinary life and political journey of Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee, an iconic figure in Indian politics and delves into the multifaceted persona of Vajpayee Ji, capturing his essence as a poet, a gentleman, and a st...

metas.name: In the Heart of the Sea
metas.description: A recounting of a New England whaling ship's sinking by a giant whale in 1820, an experience that later inspired the great novel Moby-Dick.

metas.name: Kathal: A Jackfruit Mystery
metas.description: A local politician whose prized jackfruits go missing and a young police officer who is adamant to solve this bizarre case to prove herself.

metas.name: Zwigato
metas.description: A man works as a food delivery rider, grappling with the world of ratings and incentives. To support the income, his homemaker wife begins to explore different work opportunities, with fear but also excitement of a new found indep...
